doubts: The main way's end, 'Pirongia summit viewing tower', has no ref: the names list both a peak 'Pirongia' (T10) and 'Pirongia Mountain' (T12), and the text does not say which is the summit, so it is left null. The text says the track goes 'towards' the summit viewing tower; the end is taken from that. Wharauroa Lookout and Mahaukura Lookout are given the refs of the peaks with the same names (T18, T9); this is an assumption. Grey Road car park is F3, the only Grey Road road end (where Mangakara Nature Walk meets Grey Road); the text does not name the track at the car park. The round trip (W2) is a loop because the page calls it a round trip; it starts and ends at Grey Road car park. The O'Shea Road access reaches the track by the Wharauroa Track (link L1) and is an access point, not a separate way. Pāhautea Hut is mentioned only as where people overnight on the round trip; the text does not say either way passes it, so it is not a hut on the route. No whole-way time is given for W2 other than its own heading. The Bell and Tahuanui tracks are alternatives in the safety notes, not ways of this walk.
